# Conoce tus derechos · Arizona

> A free, ad-free, zero-tracking, one-page guide in Spanish and English for immigrants and families in Arizona (Tempe, Phoenix and nearby). It gives general information, not legal advice, and lists free or low-cost immigration legal help in Arizona. The legal wording is quoted word for word from the ACLU, the ACLU of Arizona and the Arizona Legislature, each linked to its source, with the date it was read (2026-11-27).

## What it is
- Quoted ACLU text on what to do if immigration agents or police come to your door, stop you in public or in a car, come to your work, or detain someone in your family.
- Links to the ACLU Immigrants' Rights pages (English and Spanish), the Immigrant Legal Resource Center (ILRC) Red Cards and a family preparedness plan.
- A list of free or low-cost immigration legal help in Arizona, with a note about notary fraud.

## Who it is for
- People in Arizona who are worried about immigration enforcement, and their families. Spanish first, English available with the ES/EN switch.

## How to use it
- Open the page, pick Spanish or English, and use the menu buttons to jump to a situation. The page can be printed. It works without JavaScript (both languages are shown). It stores nothing and has no analytics.
- The English view is the same page at ?lang=en.

## Key links
- Page: https://brianallengit.github.io/conoce-tus-derechos-az/
- English view: https://brianallengit.github.io/conoce-tus-derechos-az/?lang=en

## Sources used
- ACLU: https://www.aclu.org/know-your-rights/immigrants-rights
- ACLU of Arizona: https://www.acluaz.org/know-your-rights/know-your-rights-during-and-after-workplace-raid/
- ILRC Red Cards: https://www.ilrc.org/red-cards-tarjetas-rojas
- U.S. Department of Justice, EOIR pro bono list: https://www.justice.gov/eoir/list-pro-bono-legal-service-providers
- ICE Online Detainee Locator: https://locator.ice.gov/odls/

## Limits
- Not legal advice. Laws and practices change. Talk to a licensed attorney or a DOJ-accredited representative about your own case.
